bottleneck: REVISED 2026-10-07 after G1 FAILED. The company now HAS an active sales motion (Coconala proposals) but it is starved by a structurally wrong supply pool: across ~67+ public requests screened in 7 days only 1 was a GO, and that got 0 reply. Coconala 公開依頼 is dominated by creative work (illustration/music/video/voice — out of an AI-automation lane), and the few in-lane requests either demand a multi-year human track record (false-claim barrier, PG-1 cond.4) or are adjacent text tasks whose buyers now EXPLICITLY reject AI-centered applicants (req 5310341). So the binding constraint is CHANNEL/AUDIENCE FIT (the request pool is wrong for an honest solo-AI provider) compounded by ZERO owned distribution (X ~tiny, 0 profile_clicks; stores 0 traffic). Fix = widen supply of well-fit buyer-posted requests (broaden Coconala GO + a higher-volume request board), not more posts or a store rebuild.
bottleneck_ja: G1失敗(10/07確定)後に改訂。販売動作（ココナラ提案）は動いているが、供給プール（公開依頼）の構造的ミスマッチで律速。7日で~67件超を審査しGOは1件・返信0。公開依頼はイラスト/音楽/動画/声など創作が大半（自動化レーン外）、数少ない適格案件も多年の人間実績要求（虚偽禁止=PG-1条件4に抵触）かAI中心の応募を明確に拒否（依頼5310341）。律速は『チャネル/客層の適合性（公開依頼の母集団が誠実なAI単独提供者に合わない）』＋『自前の流入が皆無（X極小・プロフクリック0、ストア流入0）』。打ち手は投稿増やストア再構築ではなく、適合する公開依頼の供給拡大（ココナラGO基準の拡張＋より大量の依頼ボード追加）。
